install.androidDescription: If direct installation is not available yet, use your browser menu.
install.embeddedDescription: In-app browsers may not support installation. Open this site in your system browser first.
install.openExternalBrowser: Choose Open in Browser from the app menu. On iPhone, use Safari.
install.androidMenu: Open the menu in Chrome, Edge, or your browser (usually ⋮).
install.androidAdd: Choose Install App or Add to Home Screen. In Safari, use the Share menu.
install.androidConfirm: Follow the confirmation steps. If the option is missing, use a browser that supports installation.
install.title: Add MoeMail to your home screen
install.description: Open it from an icon next time, just like an app.
install.failed: Installation could not open. Try Install or Add to Home Screen in your browser menu.
install.iosDescription: iPhone and iPad require manual installation, not an automatic system dialog.
install.share: Tap Share; on some versions, open the browser menu first.
install.addHome: Choose Add to Home Screen. If missing, enable it under Edit Actions.
install.confirm: Keep Open as Web App enabled if shown, then tap Add.
